cases.what: a lineage A → B → C of owner-signed successions verifies
a lineage out of order is refused
a history export (format shokai-history/1) verifies item by item and carries no memory plaintext
a place-signed visit receipt verifies against the place it names
a chained decision receipt recording a `never` verifies (seq 2, prev = r1's digest)
a receipt checked against another place is refused
a receipt from another place to the owner's other facet verifies on its own (per-facet subjects)
a presentation of facet 1's receipt at the bookshop, signed by both facets, verifies and links facet 1 for that audience only
the same presentation signed only by the presenting facet is refused: another facet's receipt needs that facet's signature
a presentation replayed with another nonce is refused
an owner-signed succession A → B with a 7-day overlap verifies; A's card ends when the overlap ends
a succession signed by someone other than B's card principal is refused
a succession whose overlap is longer than 14 days is refused
a memory handover envelope verifies: owner-signed, ciphertext digest bound, no plaintext
an envelope whose ciphertext was swapped is refused
